# Multiply Magic

> A fun, timed multiplication game that helps kids master their times tables.

Multiply Magic lets children practice specific multiplication tables against the clock, with multiple-choice questions, streak bonuses, high scores and a score history to track progress. It works on desktop and mobile and needs no account. Part of [skolappar.com](https://www.skolappar.com), learning apps built by parents.

## Links
